crossRefs.note: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.
that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,
Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.
The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

translations.web: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
translations.bsb: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
translations.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully
translations.asv: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me. Psalm 143 A Psalm of David.
